bio.text: Sydney Gruters is a Republican candidate for Florida's 16th Congressional District, the seat being vacated by Rep. Vern Buchanan, in 2026.

She was previously executive director and vice president of advancement at the New College of Florida Foundation, district director for Rep. Greg Steube, and state director for Florida and the U.S. Virgin Islands at USDA Rural Development.
She is married to Republican National Committee chair Joe Gruters and, in her campaign's words, is a working mother of three.

sources.title: Sarasota's Sydney Gruters Officially Announces Congressional Run
Sydney Gruters announces her candidacy to succeed Vern Buchanan in Florida's CD 16 seat
